title: People’s Mañanera July 17
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Shared Prosperity for Quintana Roo  
** Governor Mara Lezama highlighted that between 2022 and 2024, 174,000
residents of Quintana Roo rose out of poverty, while the state consolidated
sound finances, more than 527,000 formal jobs, and maintains an unemployment
rate of 2.6%. It is also advancing with strategic works such as hospitals,
53,000 Bienestar homes under construction, and projects that drive development
with social justice.

**The Security Strategy Is Delivering Results  
** Between September 2024 and June 2026, Quintana Roo reduced its daily
average of intentional homicides by 85%. President Claudia Sheinbaum
emphasized that these advances are the result of coordination among
institutions: "Quintana Roo is one of the states of the Republic that has had
the greatest decrease in intentional homicides and high-impact crimes."

**Mexico Strengthens Tourism With Public Access and Beach Protection  
** Mexico has received 42 million visitors so far this year and, despite the
global reduction in flights, was the country with the smallest drop in air
arrivals. In addition, the President presented Tulum Renace, a plan that
guarantees free public access to the beaches, free entry to Jaguar Park for
national visitors, and a comprehensive program against sargassum to protect
the beaches and reefs and strengthen tourism.

**Ernesto Ruffo Appel Arrested for Alleged Fuel Smuggling  
** Claudia Sheinbaum reported that the arrest of the PAN former governor Ruffo
Appel for fuel smuggling stemmed from an investigation begun more than a year
ago. She explained that Ruffo is a partner in one of the companies under
investigation and noted that Felipe Calderón is now coming to his defense,
despite having publicly questioned him in 2017 over alleged acts of
corruption.

She also responded to the statement in his defense by Somos México, of whose
Council Ruffo is a member, by pointing out that the evidence presented by the
FGR must first be known before turning a judicial investigation into a
political defense.

**Mexico Defends Cooperation Without Politicizing Security  
** Mexico will not take part in the summit convened by the United States on
so-called "extreme left-wing political terrorism," considering that "Political
matters do not have to become security matters, unless there is a crime to
prosecute."

She reiterated that Mexico maintains international cooperation when there are
legitimate security objectives, and announced that the Foreign Ministry will
report on the steps taken with US authorities to protect the rights of
migrants.
